## Thesis

::: {.pub-entry}
<div class="pub-title">Projeto de Classificadores de Padrões Baseados em Protótipos Usando Evolução Diferencial</div>
<div class="pub-meta">
Luiz Soares de Andrade Filho · Master's thesis, 2014<br>
Programa de Pós-Graduação em Engenharia de Teleinformática, Universidade Federal do Ceará (UFC)<br>
Concentration area: Signals and Systems · Advisor: Prof. Dr. Guilherme de Alencar Barreto
</div>
<div class="pub-meta">
*English (working translation): "Design of Prototype-Based Pattern Classifiers Using Differential Evolution."*
</div>
<div class="pub-links">
[PDF — UFC Institutional Repository](https://repositorio.ufc.br/bitstream/riufc/12478/1/2014_dis_lsandradefilho.pdf)
</div>
:::

This thesis develops prototype-based pattern classifiers whose prototypes are optimized using differential evolution, a global, population-based optimization method. This work is the origin of my background in computational intelligence, pattern recognition, and optimization methods that now inform my interest in computational and agent-based approaches to economics and public policy.

## Peer-Reviewed Publications

::: {.pub-entry}
<div class="pub-title">On the Efficient Design of a Prototype-Based Classifier Using Differential Evolution</div>
<div class="pub-meta">
Luiz A. Soares Filho · Guilherme A. Barreto · Conference paper, 2014<br>
2014 IEEE Symposium on Differential Evolution (SDE), part of the IEEE Symposium Series on Computational Intelligence (SSCI 2014)<br>
DOI: 10.1109/SDE.2014.7031535
</div>
<div class="pub-links">
[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1109/SDE.2014.7031535) [IEEE Xplore](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/7031535/) [PDF — UFC Institutional Repository](https://repositorio.ufc.br/ri/bitstream/riufc/70703/1/2014_eve_gabarreto.pdf)
</div>
:::

This paper, based on my master's thesis research, combines ideas from Learning Vector Quantization (LVQ) with a differential-evolution-based automatic clustering approach to design prototype-based classifiers — determining both the optimal number of prototypes per class and their positions in the data space.

::: {.editorial-note}
Author name as published; my legal name is Luiz Soares de Andrade Filho (see the thesis above, published under that name).
:::
